# Dr. Imran Qureshi, D.O. — Interventional Pain Management, Katy, TX

> Board-certified interventional spine & sports medicine physician in Katy, Texas. Non-surgical, opioid-free treatment for back, neck, and joint pain: epidural steroid injections, radiofrequency ablation, nerve blocks, knee gel injections, PRP therapy, and spinal cord stimulation. Serving Katy, Cinco Ranch, Fulshear, Sugar Land, Richmond, and Cypress. Phone: (281) 982-2144. Online booking via Luma Health.

All site content is written and medically reviewed by Imran Qureshi, D.O. and cites peer-reviewed and institutional sources (NIH, Cleveland Clinic, MedlinePlus). Editorial standards: https://www.drimranqureshi.com/editorial-policy

## Treatments

- [Epidural Steroid Injections](https://www.drimranqureshi.com/treatments/epidural-steroid-injections): For sciatica, herniated disc, and spinal stenosis nerve pain
- [Radiofrequency Ablation](https://www.drimranqureshi.com/treatments/radiofrequency-ablation): 9–18 months of relief for facet joint arthritis
- [Knee Gel Injections](https://www.drimranqureshi.com/treatments/knee-gel-injection): Insurance-covered hyaluronic acid viscosupplementation for knee arthritis
- [Genicular Nerve Block](https://www.drimranqureshi.com/treatments/genicular-nerve-block): For advanced knee arthritis and post-replacement pain
- [PRP Therapy](https://www.drimranqureshi.com/treatments/prp-therapy): Platelet-rich plasma for joint and tendon conditions ($750/site, transparent pricing)
- [All treatments](https://www.drimranqureshi.com/treatments)
